messages.Message sent when the assistant cannot a: Message sent when the assistant cannot answer
messages.If the AI fails, the time limit is hit o: If the AI fails, the time limit is hit or the queue gets too long, this message is sent and the chat is handed to the team; the person is never left without an answer.
messages.Minimum wait before the holding message: Minimum wait before the holding message (s)
messages.The holding message is not sent until th: The holding message is not sent until this many seconds after the person's message; meanwhile the assistant retries.

messages.When the assistant hands a chat over to: When the assistant hands a chat over to the team, a WhatsApp message is sent to these numbers from the same line: the contact's name, phone, reason, last messages and panel link. Separate with commas or new lines. The assistant does not talk to these numbers.
messages.When the contact writes one of these, th: When the contact writes one of these, the assistant immediately sends the hand-off message above and turns off in that chat. If left empty, the example list is used.

messages.Last message when a contact opts out: Last message when a contact opts out
messages.If someone writes something like \"don't: If someone writes something like "don't message me", the assistant sends this message and blocklists them. A blocklisted person gets no WhatsApp, email or SMS; manage the list under Chats › ☰ › Blocklist.
messages.Contact memory: the assistant remembers: Contact memory: the assistant remembers lasting details (form of address, relatives' names, numbers, preferences); expired chats are summarized
messages.Summarize a chat after it has been quiet: Summarize a chat after it has been quiet for (hours)

messages.How many people can be answered at the s: How many people can be answered at the same time. Assistant replies always come first; summaries do not start while someone is being answered or waiting. Each job uses one PHP worker: on shared hosting, stay under half of the total worker limit of your sites (e.g. 20-30 of 60 workers).
messages.This many workers never take summaries o: This many workers never take summaries or reminders.
messages.Summaries run only between these hours (: Summaries run only between these hours (except a manual "Summarize now"). If both are the same, any time.
